task: Fix 21 active Copilot review findings for PR 4954 round 2: dash guard, session-protocol honesty, checklistComplete inconsistency, retrospective evidence, template placeholder, reciprocal handoff link, episode causal order, QA revision-history split

events.content: Fetched and merged the current remote branch (origin/fix/2840-adr-080-amendment) into the worktree, no rebase or force, ahead of resolving PR 4954's second Copilot review round of 21 active findings.

Root-caused the session-protocol honesty finding: compared the local lefthook pre-push gate (git_hook_policy.py sessions, backing validate_branch_sessions()/session_change_scope()) against the actual CI workflow (.github/workflows/ai-session-protocol.yml running scripts/ci/validate_session_protocol.py, which calls the different committed_session_validation_modes() function).

Investigated the MUST-to-SHOULD demotion mechanism in scripts/validate_session_json.py (_validate_required_item_level) and found strong repo-wide precedent: 122 other logs demote sessionStart.serenaInstructions and 138 demote sessionEnd.serenaMemoryUpdated to SHOULD, typically for Serena-unreachable reasons. Applied this honestly to session-14695's two Incomplete MUST items, using a different but equally honest justification: that session's live window is closed, so no Aug-12 Serena evidence can be retroactively fabricated.

Ran a full six-agent adr-review (architect, critic, independent-thinker, security, analyst, high-level-advisor) against the debate log's dash-only diff, required because the file matches the ADR-review path gate even for a punctuation-only change.

Added a real commit timestamp (2026-08-15T07:09:54Z, sourced from 0edf6e063's own committer date) to the session-14695 workLog entry that the episode's e007 milestone maps to, fixing the missing-timestamp causal-order bug (extract_session_episode.py's _entry_timestamp() had fallen back to the session's nominal 2026-08-12 date). Regenerated the episode via extract_session_episode.py --preserve, not hand-edited.

Rewrote the QA report (.agents/qa/000-session-14695-adr-080-amendment-qa.md): split the single revision-history row that had misattributed the episode regen and QA rebind to commit 0edf6e063 into separate rows for 0edf6e063 (finding-4 fix only) and 5f0b54233 (the actual rebind commit), added rows for c860ae452 and this session's own commit, corrected the CI-mode evidence paragraph to accurately describe the full-mode/creation-mode discrepancy and its resolution, and rebound qaCommit to c860ae452. Also created a new QA report (.agents/qa/000-session-15001-pr-4954-round2-findings-qa.md) bound to this session log and endingCommit, since session_qa_binding() requires a QA report's qaSessionLog to match the session referencing it, and the historical report is already correctly bound to session-14695.
